title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned the mainframe operator-console direction. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Operator Console
options.lineage: 1965-78 mainframe operator consoles and their engraved panel documentation
options.thesis: The console as supervised machinery: every gateway action an engraved guarded control, every event a teleprinter line, every fence a register readout.
options.viewport: An engraved control spine replaces the sidebar; readiness becomes a lamp-and-register strip; the hero is a labeled control panel with guarded actions; logs render as a teleprinter feed.
options.case: Assigned by the roll and carries the product's own grammar: fixed action registry as engraved controls, fencing (revision/generation/cursor) as registers, sanitized log as teleprinter output.
options.risk: Reads as costume if the panel language is applied decoratively instead of carrying real state.

raised.raise: Total color discipline: saturation is spent only on state lamps; the rest of the surface is achromatic ink and hairlines.
Signal color lives in lamp glyphs and hairline edges as points, never as fills or washes.
One semantic color equals one state family, fixed in a legend and never reused decoratively.
Values set in true tabular mono at instrument contrast; hierarchy by scale contrast, not weight stacking.

options.label: Supervisor Board
options.lineage: k9s, htop and pm2-grade operations TUIs
options.thesis: The developer's daily vocabulary: dense tabular rows, column-aligned values, severity color, zero chrome.
options.viewport: The whole console as one supervisor board: sidebar becomes a process tree, status a table header, every panel a dense aligned table.
options.case: Strongest audience identification of the grounded set and trivially carries the data; it just lacks a grammar for guarded action and registry ceremony.
options.risk: The familiar landing — it is what every ops TUI already looks like; lowest novelty ceiling.

options.label: Gate Board
options.lineage: segmented boarding passes and live departure boards
options.thesis: State as a ranked board: rows rerank in place and a changed state stays lit until noticed.
options.viewport: Dashboard as a departure board: gateway state, workspaces and bindings as ranked rows that rerank and hold their change highlight.
options.case: Fuses strongly on data truth — log and workspace tables as a live board — but a board has no grammar for guarded actions or the fixed action registry.
options.risk: Reads as travel ephemera once the panel vocabulary is missing.

options.label: Nixie Counter
options.lineage: nixie-tube laboratory counters on blackened steel
options.thesis: Quantities are the interface: every metric a glowing digit bank, every label engraved caps on the chassis.
options.viewport: Metrics as glowing digit banks across the top; panels as engraved chassis sections with tube readouts for revisions, generations, cursors.
options.case: Wins raw identification — nixie is a maker icon — and owns the readout layer; a counter grammar cannot carry logs, tables, or the action registry.
options.risk: Glow-as-decoration when the digit layer is not literally the data.

options.label: Civic Prospectus
options.case: Fuses poorly: a marketing grammar cannot carry operator state; devs do not identify with council prospectuses.
options.kept: Total color discipline — the whole surface spends its saturation on one element.

options.label: Cloud Edge
options.lineage: iridescent diffraction fringes on cloud borders
options.case: Fuses poorly: pastel optics have no operational semantics and no audience identification.
options.kept: Signal color confined to edges and points; the field stays achromatic.

options.label: Gravity Garden
options.case: Fuses poorly: impossible physics reads as whimsy against supervised-infrastructure truth.
options.kept: Every color bound to exactly one meaning; the legend never competes with the field.

options.label: Variable Specimen
options.case: Fuses poorly: a specimen is a demonstration object, not an operations surface.
options.kept: Hierarchy by scale contrast alone; mono readouts as instrument labels.

canonCard.label: Modern Dev Console
canonCard.thesis: The Linear/VS Code-grade dark sidebar app this category already ships, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: The arrangement a visitor expects — left nav, header, card grid — at full craft.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other dev console by design.
